name: Dynamic-Entity
description: Declarative form engine & visual schema builder for Angular 17-22. Renders tabbed, deeply nested forms from an EntityFormConfig schema, with reactive rules, role-based visibility and masking.

paragraphs: Declarative form engine & visual schema builder for Angular 17–22

Dynamic Entity renders tabbed, deeply nested forms from a declarative EntityFormConfig schema, evaluates reactive rules as values change, applies role-based field visibility and masking, and ships a visual editor for authoring those schemas.
features: 27 field types — text, textarea, markdown, number, currency, email, password, date, datetime, time, monthYear, dropdown, radio, checkbox, boolean, multiSelect, entity-ref, group, array, image, file, url, phone, slider,…

Web, contact and scale inputs — url and phone store the text as typed, with opt-in validators.url / validators.phone format checks. A read-only url links only to http(s) addresses. slider stores a number on…

Field help text — hint on any field puts an info icon beside its label, with the text on hover and for as long as the field has focus. It is wired to the control through aria-describedby, so a screen reader gets it…

A refused save explains itself — pressing Save on an invalid form names every field at fault and what is wrong with it, badges each tab with its count, and jumps to the first. Save stays clickable while a form is merely…

Reactive rules engine — three action types (visibility to show or hide a field or tab, validation to attach an error or warning, info to raise a banner) driven by 18 condition operators including EQUAL, CONTAINS, IN,…
